## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 11.06.2026 - 05.07.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer melden Zuverlässigkeitsprobleme. Das zeigt Qualitätslücken, die Wettbewerber nutzen können.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _--becca_, 05.07.2026, 3/5: "I liked this app for tracking habits and paid to unlock it for the additional habits to track & no ads. it’s simple and easy to understand. but lately it’s been freezing every time I open the app, I think it needs an update to keep up with ios! before, I could restart the app and it would work again, right now the calendar doesn’t work at all and is showing all one emotion and you can’t click anything. update- back to just freezing once or twice per session. but better than when I couldn’t use the app at all."
            2. _Ghufghudstddhytdvgdygvgi_, 11.06.2026, 3/5: "Very cute but there is an add after every single interaction to the point where the app is nearly unusable lol"
